meta.title: WillFolks — Put your money where your goals are
meta.description: Stake money on your goals. Hit them and it's yours; miss them and it's locked. Alarms, screen time, location and AI-verified goals, held in on-chain escrow.

hero.subtitle: Stake real money on your habits. Hit the goal and it's yours again. Miss it and it stays locked — or goes to whoever beat you.

stake.title: Stake
stake.body: Pick a goal and lock real money on it. Your stake sits in an on-chain escrow, out of reach until the goal resolves.

prove.title: Prove
prove.body: Your phone's sensors, an AI agent or a network of trusted phones check whether you actually did it.

keep.title: Keep
keep.body: Did it? The money is yours, withdraw whenever. Didn't? It stays locked, or goes to whoever beat you.

win.title: You hit it
win.body: Stake released. Withdraw any time, keep the streak, feed the pet.

miss.title: You miss it
miss.body: Stake locked for the penalty period, or paid out to the friends who made it.

features.sectionTitle: Six ways to keep your word

escrow.title: Escrow & Yield
escrow.description: Stake your money on your goals. Complete them and withdraw anytime. Miss them, and your funds get locked as a penalty — or go as a multiplayer bet.

alarm.title: Smart Alarms
alarm.description: Set wake-up alarms backed by real money. Miss your alarm? Your stake gets locked. Consistency pays — literally.

appTimer.title: App Timer
appTimer.description: Limit your screen time on distracting apps. Set weekly limits and put money on the line. Your wallet keeps you focused.

locator.title: Location Tracker
locator.description: Set location-based goals. Arrive on time to the gym, office, or class. Your GPS verifies, your wallet rewards.

unmeasurable.title: AI-Powered Goals
unmeasurable.description: Goals that can't be measured by sensors — like doing homework or chores — are verified by an AI agent, or through a P2P network of trusted phones.

deposits.title: Fiat & Crypto Deposits
deposits.description: Fund your goals with traditional money or cryptocurrency. Built-in wallet with USDC support. Deposit, withdraw, and track everything on-chain.

faq.title:
Fair
questions.
faq.a1: WillFolks is a gamified savings application that helps you achieve your personal goals by locking real money in smart contracts. If you achieve your goal, you get your money back; otherwise, it is penalized or distributed in group challenges.
faq.q2: How does the Escrow mechanism work?
faq.a2: When you create a goal, you deposit an amount of money (fiat or USDC) which is securely locked in an on-chain smart contract. You can only withdraw it once it's verified that you completed the goal.
faq.q3: What happens if I miss a goal or an alarm?
faq.a3: If you don't complete the goal (for example, if you sleep through a Smart Alarm or exceed your screen time limit), the funds are temporarily locked as a penalty, or distributed among other participants in group stakes.
faq.q4: How are goals verified if they don't use sensors?
faq.a4: For goals that cannot be measured by device sensors (like studying or chores), we use AI verification to check images/videos, or peer-to-peer validation with trusted friends or phones on our decentralized network.
faq.q5: What deposit and withdrawal methods does the app support?
faq.a5: We support both traditional methods (fiat money) and cryptocurrency, with a built-in wallet compatible with USDC so that all your transactions are fast, transparent, and secure on the blockchain.
